name: Zerio Voice
author: fivem@zerio.se
description: The self-hosted voice server for Zerio-Radio V3. Needs a production licence key from portal.radio.zerio-scripts.com and an empty MySQL 8 / MariaDB 10.6+ database (create one in the server's Databases tab). Guide: https://docs.zerio-scripts.com/radio/v3/selfhosting

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# zerio-voice installer for Pterodactyl / Pelican.
# Downloads the newest release from the signed update feed with your licence key
# (the same download the "update" console command uses) and writes a starter
# config.json on the first install. A reinstall keeps config.json, instance-id,
# licence.lease and zerio-domain/.
set -euo pipefail

FEED_URL="https://updates.radio.zerio-scripts.com/v1/feed-v1.json"
PORTAL_URL="https://portal.radio.zerio-scripts.com"

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null || ! command -v curl >/dev/null; then
  apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl jq ca-certificates >/dev/null
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${LICENCE_KEY:-}" ]; then
  echo "Set the Licence key variable (your zvl_... production key from ${PORTAL_URL}) and reinstall."
  exit 1
fi

# shortcut: trusts the feed over HTTPS and checks the file's sha256 against it, but
# does not check the feed's minisign signature; the supervisor verifies every update.
release="$(curl -fsSL "$FEED_URL" | jq -c '.payload | fromjson | .majors["1"]')"
version="$(jq -r '.version' <<<"$release")"
sha256="$(jq -r '.files["linux-x64"].sha256' <<<"$release")"
echo "Newest zerio-voice: ${version}"

body="$(jq -n --arg key "$LICENCE_KEY" --arg version "$version" \
  '{key: $key, version: $version, platform: "linux-x64"}')"
links="$(curl -sS -X POST "${PORTAL_URL}/licence/download" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$body")"
url="$(jq -r '.url // empty' <<<"$links" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$url" ]; then
  echo "The portal refused the download: $(jq -r '.error // .' <<<"$links" 2>/dev/null || echo "$links")"
  echo "Check the Licence key variable."
  exit 1
fi

curl -fsSL -o zerio-voice.download "$url"
echo "${sha256}  zerio-voice.download" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
chmod +x zerio-voice.download
mv -f zerio-voice.download zerio-voice

if [ ! -f config.json ]; then
  admin_token="$(head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
  # The panel fills in server.port, database.url and licence.key from the
  # variables on every start; the rest is the normal starter config.
  jq -n --arg token "$admin_token" '{
    mode: "single",
    server: { host: "0.0.0.0", port: 30130 },
    database: { url: "" },
    auth: { admin_token: $token },
    licence: { key: "" },
    zerio_domain: true,
    updates: { check: true, supervisor: true }
  }' > config.json
  echo "Wrote config.json with a new admin token (auth.admin_token)."
fi

echo "Installed zerio-voice ${version}."

variables.name: Licence key
variables.description: Your production licence key (zvl_...) from portal.radio.zerio-scripts.com, Server page. If the install failed on the key, fix it here and reinstall.

variables.name: Database host
variables.description: The database Endpoint, host:port (for example 10.0.0.5:3306). On this panel: the server's Databases tab.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: An empty database for the voice server. It creates its own zv_* tables; don't use your FiveM database.

variables.name: Database password
variables.description: The database user's password. Passwords with # / ? or % need those characters percent-encoded (# is %23).

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Optional. The public IPv4 address players reach this server on, usually the IP shown next to its port. Leave empty to use the address the portal sees.
